sources.title: Planned long-term stay abroad — synthetic summary

passages.text: Synthetic summary: residents planning a long stay abroad may need to update their residency details and contact information with Israeli authorities before departure.
Synthetic summary: keep certified copies of civil status documents, such as birth and marriage certificates, because foreign authorities often request them with an apostille.
Synthetic summary: national insurance and health coverage can change during a long stay abroad. Check your status before you leave.
Synthetic summary: citizens returning after several years abroad may be eligible for support programmes. This demo uses two years abroad as an illustrative threshold.
Synthetic summary: eligibility is decided by the responsible authority after reviewing travel records and documents.
Synthetic summary: residents can report streetlight failures, potholes, waste and water leaks to municipal services. Reports are routed to the responsible team.
Synthetic summary: a municipal tax discount may be available for some households, for example based on income or disability. The municipality decides after a review.

label.en: How many years did you live abroad?
label.de: Wie viele Jahre haben Sie im Ausland gelebt?

all.explain: The illustrative programme is for citizens.
This demo uses two years abroad as a threshold.
